name: bgfx
description: Cross-platform, graphics API agnostic, Bring Your Own Engine/Framework style rendering library.

multithreaded.description: Encode and render on different threads

tools.$comment: Use '"host": true' in dependencies of vcpkg.json in manifest mode. shaderc uses the glslang, SPIRV-Tools, SPIRV-Cross and Tint copies that come with this bgfx release.
tools.description: Shader compiler and bin2c for bgfx.

webgpu.description: WebGPU renderer. In the browser it uses emdawnwebgpu; on the desktop it loads the Dawn library at run time.
